title: atlas.system.health.v1
description: Per-service heartbeat (docs/design/05_communication.md section 5.2: 'All services -> watchdog, Prometheus sink', 5s cadence) and docs/design/04_agent_architecture.md section 4.1's watchdog pattern: a service's own liveness signal, consumed by the Watchdog service to detect staleness and trigger fallback.

service_id.description: e.g. 'intersection_agent.42430333' -- service type + the resource it owns, so one watchdog instance can track many agent processes by heartbeat key alone.

detail.description: Free-form service-specific context (current mode, last decision latency, etc.) -- deliberately not a closed schema, since every service type reports different useful detail here.
